nodes.name: SecurityConfig.java
nodes.summary: Spring Security configuration that wires the JWT filter, OAuth2 login flow, password encoding, and public vs. protected endpoint rules for the backend API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Spring Security lambda DSL to build a stateless filter chain, whitelisting auth/public/swagger paths before requiring authentication on everything else.

nodes.name: SecurityConfig
nodes.summary: Spring @Configuration class defining the password encoder bean and the HTTP security filter chain, integrating JWT authentication and OAuth2 login handlers.

nodes.name: securityFilterChain
nodes.summary: Builds the HttpSecurity filter chain: disables CSRF, enables CORS, enforces stateless sessions, whitelists auth/public/swagger endpoints, requires authentication elsewhere, and configures the OAuth2 login flow with custom success/failure handlers.

nodes.name: AdminController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing admin-only endpoints for triggering skill extraction and job-scraper jobs, and for retrieving user/course metrics, system health, and managing users (role updates, status updates, deletion).

nodes.name: AdminController
nodes.summary: Admin REST controller aggregating platform metrics (users, courses, system health), user administration actions (role/status changes, deletion), and manual triggers for skill extraction and job scraping.

nodes.name: triggerSkillExtraction
nodes.summary: Manually triggers skill extraction and rebuilding of skill trend data via SkillExtractionService, returning success or a 500 error on failure.

nodes.name: triggerJobScraper
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that triggers the job-scraping pipeline for a given source (or all sources), delegating to JobScrapingScheduler.fetchJobs and mapping timeout/HTTP errors to appropriate response codes.

nodes.name: getUserMetric
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated user metrics (totals and growth) for the admin dashboard via AdminService.

nodes.name: getCourseMetric
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated course metrics (totals, status breakdown, progress) for the admin dashboard via AdminService.

nodes.name: getSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Returns system health information (service status, uptime, versions, DB and memory stats) via AdminService.

nodes.name: getUsers
nodes.summary: Returns a filterable list of platform users for admin management via AdminService.

nodes.name: updateUserRole
nodes.summary: Updates a user's role (e.g., promoting to admin/mentor) via AdminService, validating the request body.

nodes.name: updateUserStatus
nodes.summary: Updates a user's account status (e.g., active/suspended) via AdminService.

nodes.name: deleteUser
nodes.summary: Deletes a user account via AdminService and returns 204 No Content on success.

nodes.name: AuthController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller handling authentication flows: login, refresh-token exchange, forgot/reset password, and logout, delegating business logic to AuthService and managing auth cookies via AuthenticationCookieService.

nodes.name: AuthController
nodes.summary: REST controller for the authentication API surface: login, token refresh, forgot/reset password, and logout, coordinating AuthService and cookie management.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Authenticates a user via AuthService, sets the refresh-token cookie on the response, and returns the access token payload.

nodes.name: refreshAccount
nodes.summary: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair via AuthService, rejecting blank tokens with a 400 error and updating the refresh-token cookie.

nodes.name: forgotPassword
nodes.summary: Initiates the password-reset flow by emailing a reset link for the given account via AuthService.

nodes.name: resetPassword
nodes.summary: Completes the password-reset flow by validating the reset token and setting a new password via AuthService.

nodes.name: logout
nodes.summary: Logs the user out by invalidating the refresh token via AuthService and clearing the refresh-token cookie.

nodes.name: UserController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for authenticated user self-service operations: fetching the current profile, looking up a user by email, completing first-time profile setup, and updating the avatar image.

nodes.name: UserController
nodes.summary: REST controller for the authenticated user's profile API: view profile, lookup by email, first-time setup, and avatar upload, delegating to UserService.

nodes.name: getCurrentUser
nodes.summary: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user via UserService.

nodes.name: getUserByEmail
nodes.summary: Looks up and returns a user's profile by email address via UserService.

nodes.name: setupUserProfile
nodes.summary: Completes a new user's profile setup (name, year of birth, bio, etc.) via UserService during onboarding.

nodes.name: updateAvatar
nodes.summary: Uploads and updates the authenticated user's avatar image via UserService.

nodes.name: OAuth2UserInfoInternal.java
nodes.summary: Internal base representation of an OAuth2 provider's raw user attributes, exposing provider ID, email, name, bio, and profile URL accessors shared by provider-specific adapters.

nodes.name: OAuth2UserInfoInternal
nodes.summary: Base class wrapping the raw OAuth2 attribute map and exposing accessor methods (provider ID, email, name, bio, avatar URL) implemented by provider-specific subclasses.

nodes.name: GitHubOauth2UserInfo.java
nodes.summary: GitHub-specific OAuth2 user-info adapter that extracts provider ID, email, display name, bio, and avatar URL from the raw GitHub OAuth2 attribute map.

nodes.name: GitHubOauth2UserInfo
nodes.summary: Adapter that reads GitHub's OAuth2 user attributes (id, email, name/login, bio, avatar_url) into the common OAuth2UserInfoInternal contract.

nodes.name: GoogleOAuth2UserInfo.java
nodes.summary: Google-specific OAuth2 user-info adapter that extracts provider ID, email, and display name from the raw Google OAuth2 attribute map.

nodes.name: GoogleOAuth2UserInfo
nodes.summary: Adapter that reads Google's OAuth2 user attributes (sub, email, name) into the common OAuth2UserInfoInternal contract.

nodes.name: ForgotPasswordRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the email address used to initiate a password-reset flow.

nodes.name: LoginRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying username and password credentials submitted to the login endpoint.

nodes.name: ResetPasswordRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the reset token and new password used to complete a password reset.

nodes.name: SetupUserProfileRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying profile fields (full name, year of birth, bio) submitted during first-time user profile setup.

nodes.name: UpdateUserRoleRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the target UserRole for an admin role-update operation.

nodes.name: UpdateUserStatusRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the target UserStatus for an admin status-update operation.

nodes.name: UserRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying an email address used to look up a user record.

nodes.name: AdminCourseMetricResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO summarizing course metrics (totals, status breakdown, progress) for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: AdminSystemHealthResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO summarizing system health for the admin dashboard: overall status, per-service status, uptime, version info, and database/memory statistics.

nodes.name: AdminSystemHealthResponse
nodes.summary: Data holder for the admin system-health response, carrying status, per-service status, uptime, version, and DB/memory statistics fields.
